paragraphs: Before automating anything, I ask whether that step needs to exist at all. Often the improvement is removing, not adding.
I learn by building: I pick a real problem and solve it end to end, from getting the data to something someone can use. That’s how I learned Python, Machine Learning, and how to work with agents.
I’d rather have an honest number than a pretty one. I validate before I show and document the errors I find.
I use AI agents to design, code, and test faster. The decisions and the validation are still mine.
main.note: I also like finance: I hold the proficiency certification from Argentina’s National Securities Commission (CNV).
